subject.title: fix(cli): bound model run image reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Must model-run file ingestion guarantee prompt rejection of pipe-like paths on Windows as well as POSIX before this hardening lands?
rationale: The stated availability boundary covers user-supplied paths, but Node does not offer the POSIX nonblocking flag on Windows; maintainers need to confirm the supported cross-platform safety contract before selecting the implementation.

options.title: Require a Windows-safe rejection path
options.body: Keep the PR's no-hang security goal cross-platform by adding a Windows-safe acquisition/rejection strategy and proving it before merge.

options.title: Narrow the hardening contract
options.body: Land only if maintainers explicitly scope the claim to supported POSIX behavior and accept that Windows requires separate follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Require a Windows-safe rejection path
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's no-hang security goal cross-platform by adding a Windows-safe acquisition/rejection strategy and proving it before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current nonblocking-open approach and are best placed to assess the intended platform boundary.
